name: @crowley/rag-mcp

tools.name: search_codebase
tools.description: Search the default codebase. Returns file locations, symbols, and graph connections. Use Read tool to view the actual code at returned locations.

language.description: Filter by language (typescript, python, vue, etc.)

layer.description: Filter by architectural layer (api, service, util, model, middleware, test, parser, types, config, other)

tools.name: search_similar
tools.description: Find code similar to a given snippet.

code.description: Code snippet to find similar code for

tools.name: grouped_search
tools.description: Search default codebase grouped by file. Returns file locations with symbols and connections. Use Read tool to view the actual code.

layer.description: Filter by architectural layer (api, service, util, etc.)

tools.name: hybrid_search
tools.description: Hybrid search combining keyword matching and semantic similarity for default. Returns file locations with symbols and connections. Use Read tool to view code.

semanticWeight.description: Weight for semantic vs keyword (0-1, default: 0.7)

layer.description: Filter by architectural layer (api, service, util, etc.)

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search documentation in the default project.

tools.name: get_project_stats
tools.description: Get statistics about the default codebase.

tools.name: find_symbol
tools.description: Find a function, class, type, or interface by name in default. Fast symbol lookup without full-text search.

symbol.description: Symbol name to find (function, class, type, etc.)

kind.description: Filter by kind: function, class, interface, type, enum, const

tools.name: search_graph
tools.description: Search default codebase with graph expansion. Returns file locations plus connected files via import/call relationships. Use Read tool to view code.

expandHops.description: Number of graph hops to expand (default: 1)

tools.name: ask_codebase
tools.description: Ask a question about the default codebase. Uses RAG + LLM to provide contextual answers.

tools.name: explain_code
tools.description: Get a detailed explanation of a code snippet.

tools.name: find_feature
tools.description: Find where a specific feature is implemented in the default codebase.

description.description: Description of the feature to find

tools.name: analyze_conversation
tools.description: Analyze a conversation to extract learnings, decisions, and insights for default.

minConfidence.description: Minimum confidence threshold for learnings (0-1, default: 0.7)

tools.name: auto_remember
tools.description: Automatically classify and remember information for default. Analyzes content to determine the best memory type.

tools.name: index_codebase
tools.description: Index or re-index the default codebase for RAG search.

force.description: Force re-index even if already indexed

tools.name: get_index_status
tools.description: Get the indexing status for default codebase. Results cached for 30 minutes.

tools.name: reindex_zero_downtime
tools.description: Reindex default codebase with zero downtime using alias swap.

tools.name: list_aliases
tools.description: List all collection aliases and their mappings.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Store important information in agent memory. Use this to save decisions, insights, context, todos, or important conversations for future reference.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Retrieve relevant memories based on context. Searches agent memory for past decisions, insights, and notes related to the query.

tools.name: list_memories
tools.description: List recent memories or filter by type/tags. Shows what the agent has remembered.

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Delete a specific memory by ID or clear memories by type.

type.description: Delete all memories of this type

olderThanDays.description: Delete memories older than N days

tools.name: update_todo
tools.description: Update status of a todo/task in memory.

tools.name: batch_remember
tools.description: Efficiently store multiple memories at once in default. Faster than individual remember calls.

tools.name: validate_memory
tools.description: Validate or reject an auto-extracted memory in default. Helps improve future extraction accuracy.

memoryId.description: ID of the memory to validate

validated.description: true to confirm the memory is valuable, false to reject it

tools.name: review_memories
tools.description: Get auto-extracted memories pending review in default. Shows unvalidated learnings that need human confirmation.

tools.name: promote_memory
tools.description: Promote a quarantine memory to durable storage in default. Requires a reason for promotion. Optionally runs quality gates before promotion.

memoryId.description: ID of the memory to promote

runGates.description: Run quality gates before promotion (default: false)

affectedFiles.description: Files affected by this memory (for quality gate checking)

tools.name: run_quality_gates
tools.description: Run quality gates (typecheck, tests, blast radius) for default.

affectedFiles.description: Files to check (for related tests and blast radius)

tools.name: memory_maintenance
tools.description: Run feedback-driven memory maintenance for default: auto-promote memories with 3+ positive feedback, auto-prune memories with 2+ incorrect feedback.

tools.name: record_adr
tools.description: Record an Architecture Decision Record (ADR). Use this to document important architectural decisions, technology choices, and design patterns for default.

title.description: Short title for the decision (e.g., 'Use WebSocket for real-time updates')

context.description: Why this decision was needed - the problem or requirement

consequences.description: Positive and negative consequences of this decision

tools.name: get_adrs
tools.description: Get Architecture Decision Records for default. Search by topic or list all ADRs.

query.description: Search query (optional - returns all if empty)

tools.name: record_pattern
tools.description: Record an architectural pattern used in default. Patterns define how specific types of code should be structured.

description.description: What this pattern is for and when to use it

structure.description: How code following this pattern should be structured (file organization, naming, etc.)

example.description: Example code or file reference demonstrating the pattern

appliesTo.description: Where this pattern applies (e.g., 'backend/src/modules/*', 'all API endpoints')

tools.name: get_patterns
tools.description: Get architectural patterns for default. Use to understand how to structure new code.

query.description: Search for patterns by name or description

appliesTo.description: Filter by what patterns apply to (e.g., 'api', 'module')

tools.name: check_architecture
tools.description: Check if code or a feature follows established architectural patterns. Analyzes code against recorded patterns and ADRs.

filePath.description: File path for context (helps determine which patterns apply)

featureDescription.description: Description of what the code does (alternative to providing code)

tools.name: suggest_architecture
tools.description: Get architectural guidance for implementing a new feature. Suggests structure, patterns to follow, and relevant ADRs.

tools.name: record_tech_debt
tools.description: Record technical debt or architectural violation that needs to be addressed later.

title.description: Short description of the tech debt

location.description: Where in the codebase (file paths, modules)

relatedAdr.description: Related ADR ID if this violates a decision

tools.name: get_tech_debt
tools.description: List technical debt items for default.

tools.name: analyze_project_structure
tools.description: Analyze the current project structure and compare with established patterns. Identifies inconsistencies and suggests improvements.

path.description: Specific path to analyze (default: entire project)

deep.description: Perform deep analysis including code patterns (default: false)

tools.name: record_table
tools.description: Record a database table definition with its purpose, columns, and relationships. Use this to document the database schema for default.

purpose.description: What this table is for and when it's used

columns.description: Key columns and their purposes (format: 'column_name: description')

rules.description: Business rules and constraints for this table

tools.name: get_table_info
tools.description: Get documented information about a database table including its purpose, columns, relationships, and rules.

tableName.description: Table name to look up (or 'all' to list all tables)

tools.name: record_db_rule
tools.description: Record a database rule or constraint that should be followed. Use this for data integrity rules, naming conventions, or query patterns.

examples.description: Good and bad examples of applying this rule

tools.name: get_db_rules
tools.description: Get database rules and constraints for default. Filter by scope or get all rules.

tools.name: record_enum
tools.description: Record a database enum type with its values and usage. Use this to document allowed values for status fields, types, etc.

values.description: List of enum values with descriptions (format: 'value: description')

usedIn.description: Tables and columns where this enum is used

tools.name: get_enums
tools.description: Get documented enum types for default database.

enumName.description: Specific enum to look up (or empty for all)

tools.name: check_db_schema
tools.description: Check if a proposed database change follows the documented rules and patterns. Use before creating migrations.

change.description: Description of the proposed change (new table, column, index, etc.)

sql.description: Optional SQL or Prisma schema for the change

tools.name: suggest_db_schema
tools.description: Get suggestions for database schema design for a new feature or data requirement.

requirement.description: What data needs to be stored or what feature needs support

relatedTables.description: Existing tables that might be related

tools.name: search_confluence
tools.description: Search indexed Confluence documentation for default. Returns relevant pages with content snippets.

tools.name: index_confluence
tools.description: Index Confluence spaces/pages for default. Requires Confluence credentials in RAG API.

spaceKeys.description: Specific space keys to index (indexes all accessible if empty)

force.description: Force re-index even if already indexed

tools.name: get_confluence_status
tools.description: Check if Confluence integration is configured and available.

tools.name: list_confluence_spaces
tools.description: List available Confluence spaces that can be indexed.

tools.name: search_requirements
tools.description: Search technical requirements and product documentation for default. Finds relevant requirements, user stories, and specifications from Confluence.

query.description: Search query for requirements (e.g., 'video inspection flow', 'payment integration')

tools.name: analyze_requirements
tools.description: Analyze technical requirements and compare with existing implementation in default. Identifies gaps, missing features, and implementation status.

feature.description: Feature or requirement to analyze (e.g., 'video inspection', 'notifications')

tools.name: estimate_feature
tools.description: Estimate development effort for a feature based on requirements and codebase analysis. Returns complexity assessment, affected files, and risk factors.

tools.name: get_feature_status
tools.description: Get implementation status of a feature by comparing requirements with codebase. Shows what's implemented, in progress, and missing.

tools.name: list_requirements
tools.description: List all documented requirements/features for default from Confluence. Groups by category or status.

tools.name: ask_pm
tools.description: Ask product management questions about default. Answers questions about requirements, features, priorities, and project status using both documentation and codebase.

question.description: PM question (e.g., 'What features are planned for video inspection?', 'What's the status of notifications?')

tools.name: generate_spec
tools.description: Generate technical specification from requirements. Creates a structured spec document based on Confluence requirements and existing codebase patterns.

tools.name: review_code
tools.description: Review code for issues, pattern violations, and improvements. Uses project patterns and ADRs for context.

diff.description: Git diff to review instead of full code

tools.name: generate_tests
tools.description: Generate unit/integration tests based on code and existing test patterns in the project.

testType.description: Type of tests to generate (default: unit)

tools.name: analyze_tests
tools.description: Analyze existing tests for coverage and quality.

tools.name: get_tool_analytics
tools.description: Get tool usage analytics for default. Shows call counts, success rates, and performance.

tools.name: get_knowledge_gaps
tools.description: Get knowledge gaps for default. Shows queries that returned few or no results.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: Get detailed analytics for a default collection. Shows vectors, storage, language breakdown, and more.

collectionName.description: Collection name to get analytics for (e.g., 'codebase', 'docs', 'memory')

tools.name: backup_collection
tools.description: Create a backup snapshot of a default collection.

tools.name: list_backups
tools.description: List backup snapshots for a default collection.

collectionName.description: Collection name to list backups for

tools.name: enable_quantization
tools.description: Enable scalar quantization on a default collection to reduce memory usage.

collectionName.description: Collection name to enable quantization on

tools.name: get_platform_stats
tools.description: Get cross-project platform statistics. Shows all projects, their collections, and aggregated metrics.

tools.name: get_prediction_stats
tools.description: Get predictive loader stats for default. Shows prediction accuracy, hit rates, and strategy breakdown.

sessionId.description: Session ID to get stats for. If omitted, returns aggregate stats.

tools.name: cluster_code
tools.description: Cluster code in the default codebase by similarity. Groups related files around seed points.

seedIds.description: Seed point IDs to cluster around

tools.name: find_duplicates
tools.description: Find duplicate or near-duplicate code in default. Groups similar files by content.

tools.name: recommend_similar
tools.description: Recommend similar code based on positive and negative examples in default.

positiveIds.description: IDs of vectors to find similar code to

tools.name: extract_learnings
tools.description: Extract learnings and insights from text for default. Identifies decisions, patterns, and concepts.

tools.name: summarize_context
tools.description: Summarize the current working context for default. Shows recently used tools, active features, recent queries, and suggested next steps.

sessionId.description: Session ID to get context for. If omitted, returns the latest context.

tools.name: summarize_changes
tools.description: Summarize changes made during a session for default. Shows what was modified, tools used, and key actions taken.

sessionId.description: Session ID to summarize changes for.

includeCode.description: Whether to include code snippets in the summary (default: false).

tools.name: analyze_usage_patterns
tools.description: Analyze tool usage patterns for default. Shows common workflows, detected patterns, and recommendations for improving productivity.

tools.name: get_developer_profile
tools.description: Get accumulated developer profile for default: frequent files, preferred tools, peak hours, common patterns.

tools.name: start_session
tools.description: Start a new working session for default. Tracks tool usage, file changes, and learnings throughout the session.

sessionId.description: Custom session ID. If omitted, one will be generated.

initialContext.description: Description of what this session is about (e.g., 'fixing auth bug', 'adding new API endpoint').

resumeFrom.description: Session ID to resume from. Carries over context from the previous session.

tools.name: get_session_context
tools.description: Get the current context for an active session in default. Shows files being worked on, tools used, and pending learnings.

sessionId.description: Session ID to get context for.

tools.name: end_session
tools.description: End a working session for default. Saves a summary and optionally extracts learnings for future sessions.

summary.description: Summary of what was accomplished during the session.

autoSaveLearnings.description: Automatically save detected learnings to memory (default: true).

feedback.description: Optional feedback about the session (e.g., 'productive', 'too many context switches').

tools.name: feedback_search
tools.description: Provide feedback on a search result quality for default. Helps improve future search results.

file.description: The file from results being rated

suggestedQuery.description: A better query that would have found the right results

tools.name: feedback_memory
tools.description: Provide feedback on a memory's accuracy for default. Helps keep memory quality high.

memoryId.description: The memory ID to provide feedback on

correction.description: Corrected information if the memory is wrong

tools.name: suggest_better_query
tools.description: Get query improvement suggestions based on feedback patterns for default.

query.description: The query to get suggestions for

context.description: Additional context about what you are looking for

tools.name: get_quality_metrics
tools.description: Get search and memory quality metrics for default.

tools.name: context_briefing
tools.description: REQUIRED before code changes. Parallel lookup of recall + search + patterns + ADRs + graph for default. One call replaces 5 separate RAG lookups.

tools.name: get_contextual_suggestions
tools.description: Get contextual suggestions based on current work context for default. Returns relevant suggestions, triggers, and related memories.

tools.name: suggest_related_code
tools.description: Find code related to a given file or snippet in default. Shows similar implementations and related modules.

file.description: File path to find related code for

code.description: Code snippet to find related code for

tools.name: suggest_implementation
tools.description: Get implementation suggestions for a feature in default. Shows similar patterns and adaptation hints.

tools.name: suggest_tests
tools.description: Get test suggestions for code in default. Shows recommended test types, frameworks, and example patterns.

framework.description: Test framework preference (jest, mocha, pytest, etc.)

tools.name: get_code_context
tools.description: Get full context for a code file in default. Shows imports, related code, and test patterns.

file.description: File path to get context for

tools.name: setup_project
tools.description: Configure Claude Code for RAG integration. Creates/updates .mcp.json, adds RAG instructions to CLAUDE.md, and configures permissions. Call after index_codebase on a new project.

ragApiUrl.description: RAG API URL (default: from MCP env)

ragApiKey.description: RAG API key (default: from MCP env)

updateClaudeMd.description: Add RAG section to CLAUDE.md (default: true)

tools.name: get_cache_stats
tools.description: Get cache statistics for default. Shows hit rates, cache levels, and memory usage.

sessionId.description: Optional session ID for session-specific stats

tools.name: warm_cache
tools.description: Warm the embedding cache for default. Pre-loads frequently used embeddings for faster responses.

sessionId.description: Session ID to warm cache for

previousSessionId.description: Previous session to copy cache from (for session resumption)

recentQueries.description: Recent queries to pre-warm in cache

tools.name: get_rag_guidelines
tools.description: Get recommended settings and best practices for working with RAG in default. Shows optimal tool usage patterns, query strategies, and session management tips.

context.description: Current work context for tailored recommendations

tools.name: merge_memories
tools.description: Consolidate duplicate memories for default. Finds similar memories and merges them using LLM to reduce clutter.

type.description: Filter by memory type (decision, insight, context, todo, conversation, note, or all). Default: all

threshold.description: Similarity threshold for merging (0.5-1.0, default: 0.9). Lower = more aggressive merging.

dryRun.description: If true, preview merge candidates without making changes (default: true).

tools.name: get_completion_context
tools.description: Get code completion context for default. Finds similar patterns, imports, and symbols from the codebase to aid code completion.

currentFile.description: Path of the file being edited

currentCode.description: Current code snippet or file content

tools.name: get_import_suggestions
tools.description: Suggest missing imports for default. Analyzes similar files to find commonly used imports not present in your current file.

currentFile.description: Path of the file being edited

tools.name: get_type_context
tools.description: Look up type/interface/class definitions and usage in default. Finds where a type is defined and how it's used across the codebase.

typeName.description: Name of the type/interface/class to look up

code.description: Code containing types to look up (alternative to typeName)

currentFile.description: Current file to exclude from results

tools.name: get_behavior_patterns
tools.description: Analyze user workflow patterns for default. Shows peak hours, tool preferences, common sequences, and session statistics.

tools.name: run_agent
tools.description: Run a specialized agent for default. Agents autonomously research, review, or analyze using multiple tool calls. Returns result + reasoning trace.

type.description: Agent type: research, review, documentation, refactor, or test

task.description: The task for the agent to perform

maxIterations.description: Maximum ReAct iterations (default: varies by agent type)

tools.name: get_agent_types
tools.description: List available agent types for default with descriptions.
